sentences.japanese: 私はこのプロジェクトに参加できることを誇りに思います。
sentences.english: I am proud to be a part of this project.

sentences.japanese: お前のことを誇りに思うよ。

sentences.english: I was also impressed with the school's cleanliness and the students' pride in it.

sentences.japanese: 我が党にもようやく、誇りをもって出せる候補者ができた。
